title: Third Party Operations Specialist
description:
Third Party Operations Specialist 
New York, NY (Hybrid) 
Pay: $36.00 - $37.50 per hour 
26-06899

Job Summary

The Third Party Operations Specialist is responsible for supporting the onboarding, setup, compliance, and ongoing governance of third-party suppliers within the Supply Chain organization. This role maintains supplier records, processes supplier requests, manages compliance documentation, and supports third-party risk management activities to ensure suppliers meet internal policies and regulatory requirements. The Specialist collaborates with cross-functional teams to strengthen supplier governance, improve operational efficiency, and enhance the supplier and internal customer experience.

Job Responsibilities

  • Facilitate the onboarding, setup, and maintenance of third-party suppliers while ensuring the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of supplier records.
  • Process supplier setup, updates, and compliance requests in accordance with established policies and procedures.
  • Maintain supplier data within Oracle EBS and ensure information remains current and accurate.
  • Review and maintain certificates of insurance (COI), policy documentation, and related compliance records.
  • Support third-party risk management processes, supplier governance activities, and internal audits.
  • Collaborate with Supply Chain, Legal, Risk Management, and business partners to resolve supplier issues and support procurement activities.
  • Monitor pending supplier requests and coordinate with internal stakeholders to minimize operational disruptions.
  • Maintain Supply Chain intranet resources and related documentation to ensure current information is available.
  • Analyze supplier data and business requests to ensure compliance with internal controls and regulatory requirements.
  • Incorporate feedback from internal customers, suppliers, and team members to improve service quality and operational performance.
  • Promote a safe, inclusive, and professional work environment while adhering to organizational policies and standards.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Job Requirements

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in Supply Chain, procurement, supplier operations, analytics, data analysis, or a related field required.
  • Bachelor's degree in a related field required.
  • Experience with Oracle EBS required.
  • Experience supporting third-party risk management processes required.
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office applications required.
  • Experience reviewing and analyzing data with strong attention to detail.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Excellent organizational and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and business partners.
  • Experience with supplier onboarding processes preferred.
  • Experience managing certificates of insurance (COI) preferred.
  • Experience auditing supplier or operational data preferred.
  • Knowledge of procurement and supply chain processes preferred.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in a related field required.

Work Experience

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in Supply Chain, procurement, supplier operations, analytics, data analysis, or a related field required.
  • Experience with Oracle EBS required.
  • Experience supporting third-party risk management processes required.
  • Experience with supplier onboarding preferred.
  • Experience managing certificates of insurance (COI) preferred.
  • Experience auditing supplier or operational data preferred.

title: HR Service Center Representative
description:
HR Service Center Representative 
Irving, TX (Hybrid) 
Pay: $25.00 - $27.00 per hour 
26-06897
Job Summary

The HR Service Center Representative is responsible for providing Tier 1 HR support through multiple communication channels, including phone, chat, email, and case management systems. This role serves as a primary point of contact for employees, managers, and internal stakeholders by resolving inquiries related to human resources, payroll, timekeeping, travel and expense, benefits, and employee lifecycle processes. The position also supports continuous process improvement initiatives through the use of AI-powered technologies and automation tools while ensuring compliance with established service standards and data privacy requirements.

Job Responsibilities

  • Provide timely, accurate, and professional support for human resources inquiries through phone, chat, email, and case management systems.
  • Resolve employee inquiries related to payroll, benefits, timekeeping, travel and expense, employee records, and HR policies.
  • Utilize knowledge base resources, troubleshooting techniques, and AI-assisted tools to resolve customer issues.
  • Document customer interactions and resolutions accurately within the case management system.
  • Meet established service level agreements (SLAs) for response time, quality, and customer satisfaction.
  • Manage complex or sensitive customer interactions with professionalism and discretion.
  • Escalate issues appropriately when additional support or specialized expertise is required.
  • Perform administrative HR support functions, including employment verification, document management, employee record updates, workplace accommodations, and related employee service activities.
  • Maintain confidentiality while ensuring compliance with company policies, data privacy standards, and regulatory requirements.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve service delivery and operational effectiveness.
  • Participate in continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to streamline processes through AI-driven chatbots, voice assistants, and robotic process automation (RPA).
  • Continuously expand technical and functional knowledge of HR technologies and support processes.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Job Requirements

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in a human resources shared services, HR support, or call center environment required.
  • High school diploma or GED required; bachelor's degree preferred.
  • Experience supporting high-volume customer service environments using case management or ticketing systems.
  • Experience utilizing AI-driven chatbots, voice assistants, and robotic process automation (RPA) solutions.
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage confidential and sensitive information with discretion.
  • Strong customer service skills with the ability to resolve complex employee inquiries.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Knowledge of human resources, payroll, timekeeping, and employee service processes preferred.
  • Experience with HR information systems and service management platforms, including Workday and ServiceNow, preferred.
  • Knowledge of travel and expense processes preferred.
  • Ability to adapt to changing technologies and continuously improve operational processes.

Education

  • High school diploma or GED required.
  • Bachelor's degree preferred.

Work Experience

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in a human resources shared services, HR support, or call center environment required.
  • Experience supporting high-volume customer service operations using case management or ticketing systems required.
  • Experience utilizing AI-driven chatbots, voice assistants, and robotic process automation (RPA) solutions required.

title: HR Generalist
description:
Human Resources Generalist

Position Summary

The Human Resources Generalist is the company's sole, dedicated HR professional, owning the full employee lifecycle—recruiting, onboarding, benefits, compliance, employee relations, and offboarding—for approximately 35 office and field employees, plus light administrative support to office operations and Finance. Reporting to the Senior Accounting Manager and partnering with the President on culture and engagement, this hands-on role strengthens the employee-ownership culture while keeping the company compliant and well-run as it grows.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage full-cycle recruiting for field and office roles, and lead onboarding, including pre-employment screenings, new-hire paperwork, and systems setup.
  • Onboard union personnel as company employees (including short-term hires), ensuring correct documentation, classification, and rate setup; the company is an open-shop contractor that staffs union labor on certain projects.
  • Manage offboarding, including exit logistics, final pay, and ESOP/benefits transitions.
  • Own and process payroll, including union payroll, in the company's UKG platform, ensuring correct rates and classifications.
  • Maintain confidential personnel records and HR systems, and develop HR policies and the employee handbook as the company grows.
  • Support compliance with federal and New Jersey employment laws (FLSA, FMLA/NJ leave, ACA, EEO, I-9/E-Verify, and federal-contractor obligations).
  • Administer benefits (health, 401(k), leave, and open enrollment) as the primary employee contact, and coordinate ESOP communications and recordkeeping with the plan administrator and accounting team.
  • Lead engagement, recognition, and communication efforts that reinforce employee ownership; serve as a confidential resource for employee relations, investigations, and conflict resolution; and support performance management, including review cycles, manager coaching, and documentation.
  • Coordinate workers' compensation claims and safety/OSHA recordkeeping with field and operations teams (HR coordinates but does not own safety), and support process improvements that scale with growth.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of progressive HR generalist experience, ideally as a sole or small-team HR function; construction, heavy civil, or federal/state contracting experience a plus.
  • Working knowledge of federal and New Jersey employment law and compliance obligations.
  • Bachelor's degree preferred (Human Resources, Business, or related) or equivalent experience; SHRM-CP, SHRM-SCP, PHR, or SPHR certification a plus.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word); experience running payroll in an HRIS system, ideally UKG.
  • Highly organized self-starter who communicates clearly, builds trust across office and field teams, and thrives in a fast-paced, evolving company.
  • Reliable transportation and a valid driver's license.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary: $70,000–$80,000+, commensurate with experience, with annual bonus potential.
  • Comprehensive benefits: 100% employer-paid health coverage, automatic 4% employer 401(k) contribution, ESOP participation, and opportunities for professional growth.

title: Certified Industrial Hygienist (CIH)
description:
Certified Industrial Hygienist (CIH)
Hybrid position
San Francisco, CA *California preferred; however, candidates outside California may be considered if willing to travel as needed
26-06787
Job Summary

The Certified Industrial Hygienist (CIH) is to provide technical leadership and oversight for Legionella assessment, monitoring, and reporting activities. This role serves as the Competent Professional responsible for developing risk assessments, directing field sampling activities, reviewing laboratory results, and certifying final technical reports. The ideal candidate has extensive experience in industrial hygiene, environmental health, Legionella investigations, and regulatory compliance, with the ability to support projects across multiple facilities.

Job Responsibilities

  • Serve as the Competent Professional in accordance with the AIHA Technical Framework for Legionella (2020).
  • Establish monitoring locations and recommend appropriate control measures.
  • Develop Legionella risk assessments based on laboratory analysis and field observations.
  • Direct and oversee the activities of Competent Technicians performing field sampling.
  • Determine sampling quantities and locations in coordination with project stakeholders.
  • Review laboratory results, technical findings, and supporting documentation.
  • Sign, certify, and approve final survey reports and technical deliverables.
  • Provide technical leadership and quality oversight throughout all phases of project execution.
  • Support Legionella testing, assessment, and reporting activities as needed.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable environmental health, safety, and regulatory requirements.
  • Collaborate with project teams, laboratories, and clients to support successful project delivery.

Job Requirements

  • Current Certified Industrial Hygienist (CIH) certification required.
  • Strong knowledge of industrial hygiene principles, environmental health, and risk assessment methodologies.
  • Experience performing Legionella assessments and investigations.
  • Experience developing and implementing Water Management Programs (WMPs).
  • Knowledge of microbial industrial hygiene investigations.
  • Experience preparing technical reports and communicating findings.
  • Familiarity with ISO 11731 Legionella testing standards.
  • Knowledge of California Title 24 requirements is preferred.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to travel as required to support project needs.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Industrial Hygiene, Environmental Health, Occupational Health, Environmental Science, Engineering, or a related field required.
  • Advanced degree is preferred.

Work Experience

  • Experience performing industrial hygiene assessments and environmental health consulting.
  • Experience supporting Legionella testing, investigations, and risk assessments.
  • Experience supporting government, healthcare, institutional, or large commercial facilities is preferred.
  • Experience with technical report preparation and regulatory compliance.

title: Traveling Maintenance Technician
description:
Multi-Craft Traveling Maintenance Technician

6‑Month Contract-to-Hire
 
Location: Rochester, NY
 
Pay: $28–$35/hr 
 
Overview
We are hiring a Traveling Electrical Maintenance Technician to support multiple FedEx distribution facilities across the region. This role is primarily electrical, with a strong focus on three‑phase wiring, 480V motor work, frequency drives, and electrical troubleshooting on conveyor and material‑handling equipment. Mechanical maintenance is still part of the job, but the manager is specifically seeking someone with industrial electrical depth who can travel daily to different customer sites.This position is ideal for a technician who enjoys autonomy, problem‑solving, and working in fast‑paced distribution environments.
 
Key Responsibilities
Electrical (Primary Focus)

  • Troubleshoot and repair three‑phase electrical systems, including 480V motors, motor starters, VFDs, and control circuits
  • Diagnose electrical issues using schematics, wiring diagrams, and control drawings (including 3‑wire start/stop circuits and lighting circuits)
  • Work with 110V–480V systems, relays, timers, switches, contactors, and overloads
  • Identify issues in circuits where proper phase‑to‑phase power is required (e.g., 480V lighting or motor circuits)
  • Perform electrical PMs across multiple FedEx facilities
 
Mechanical (Secondary)
  • Perform mechanical repairs on conveyors, rollers, belts, bearings, and related equipment
  • Light MIG welding (iron/light gauge) as needed
  • Support general maintenance tasks when required
  • Travel & Customer Support
  • Travel daily to different FedEx locations within the region
  • Provide on‑call support (1 week on / 2 weeks off rotation)
  • Represent the company professionally in customer-facing environments
  • Document work performed and communicate findings to site contacts
 
Requirements
  • Strong industrial electrical background — three‑phase wiring and 480V motor experience required
  • Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, including:
            -3phase lighting circuits
            -3wire stop/start circuits
            -Contactors, overloads, and coil logic
  • Experience with frequency drives (VFDs) and understanding how they control AC motor speed
  • Experience troubleshooting conveyor systems or material‑handling equipment
  • Ability to diagnose electrical issues up to the PLC input/output level (no PLC programming required)
  • Mechanical aptitude and willingness to perform maintenance tasks as needed
  • MIG welding experience preferred
  • Valid driver’s license and ability to travel daily
  • Ability to meet a 2‑hour on‑call response window
  • Strong communication and customer service skills
  • Schedule & Pay
  • On‑call rotation: 1 week on / 2 weeks off
  • Paid from the time you leave home
  • Company vehicle provided after demonstrating reliability
